# Tenth pass (generated by scripts/make_stats_p17.py; pre-registered in LOG.md)

Hole-robust labels: a ground-truth point the depth test calls unobserved but a z-buffer of the whole scan calls visible in an input view is ambiguous and left out of both classes. A cell qualifies if the unobserved share averages at least 0.5% (and, where the alignment is fitted on pixels, at least 0.5 of them lie on the scanned surface); the claim holds if the label-free head beats native confidence at p < 0.05 (paired sign-flip over scenes).
